quote: The secondary-eye retinas of the salticoid and spartaeine species that have been studied ... are, compared to the secondary-eye retinas of L. viridis, more refined in how they are adapted for motion detec- tion.
note: Same page: in Yaginumanis the retina resembles 'L. viridis by having no screening pigment at the level of the rhabdoms'. Salticoid secondary retinas have pigment between receptors that reduces optical noise.
